title: Advance Trading Robot 1: RSI grid with martingale (capped 2 lots)
entry_long: RSI oversoldfull region + grid entry every 10 pips
entry_short: RSI overbought region + grid entry every 10 pips
exit: trailing stop 500/step100; take profit target; no stop loss
buildon_idea: Capped at 2 lots with RSI filter; test flat-lot performance first; verify grid spacing adaptability across symbols
novelty_note: RSI-based grid entry with trailing stop; common pattern - moderate novelty

title: Advance Trading Robot 2: RSI + Doji with martingale/grid modes
entry_long: RSI oversold + bullish doji (wick filter; lower wick >= 40% of candle)
entry_short: RSI overbought + bearish doji (upper wick >= 40% of candle)
exit: take profit 60 pips; stop loss 30 pips
buildon_idea: Dual mode (martingale vs grid) selectable; test grid mode extensivity; add position cap if uncapped in martingale mode
novelty_note: RSI + doji pattern filtering; mode selector adds flexibility

title: Advance Trading Robot 3: MACD Classic/Hidden Divergence (2-group grid)
entry_long: MACD classic bullish divergence (group 1) or hidden bullish divergence (group 2)
entry_short: MACD classic bearish divergence (group 1) or hidden bearish divergence (group 2)
exit: take profit 5 USD; cut loss 30% of balance
buildon_idea: Two independent groups allow parallel divergence tracking; test correlation between groups; scaling cap at 15/group is conservative - test expansion to 20-30 with symbol diversification
novelty_note: Dual-mode divergence (classic+hidden) with grouped grid; MACD divergence mechanically solid

title: Go Robot Scouting: Time Bomb rate-of-change detector
entry_long: TimeBomb Up detects 10 pips/10sec rate; opens buy at 0.01 lot with 60 pips SL
entry_short: TimeBomb Down detects 10 pips/10sec rate; opens sell at 0.01 lot with 60 pips SL
exit: grid add: +60 pips = 2x lot; trailing stop: 30 pips; close at profit target
buildon_idea: Rate-of-change timing signal is novel; test parameter sensitivity (10/10 -> 8/12, 15/10); add DD guardrail below 20%
novelty_note: TimeBomb is proprietary fxDreema block for rate detection; tested 2023-09-2024 on XAU, 139.99% profit, 962 orders

title: Advance Trading Robot: Buy/Sell pending orders with martingale auto-escalation
entry_long: Buy Stop pending 500 pips above; triggers on spike up; escalates 2x lot on consecutive losses
entry_short: Sell Stop pending 500 pips below; triggers on spike down; escalates 2x lot on consecutive losses
exit: take profit 500 pips; stop loss 300 pips
buildon_idea: Pending order auto-cancels opposite when filled; martingale escalation with 10-loss cap is reasonable; test scalping_mode flag for ATR-filtered entry vs unrestricted
novelty_note: Pending order dual-zone strategy; escalation capped at 10 consecutive losses

title: Grid Trading Robot: EMA + candlestick pattern with dynamic TP
entry_long: EMA short > EMA long + bullish candle (body filter)
entry_short: EMA short < EMA long + bearish candle (body filter)
exit: Modify TP to average price + 50 pips; cut loss at 30% balance
buildon_idea: TP modification tied to average entry price is elegant; test 2-group separation to avoid conflicting TP levels; extend symbol base (currently EMA params not symbol-specific)
novelty_note: Dynamic TP tied to grid average price is semi-novel; candlestick body filter is standard

title: Dynamic Grid Distance & Auto Lot Scaling: exponential expansion
entry_long: Candle pattern (lower wick >= 40% of 100 pip minimum) + grid entry; lot += 2x per level; grid distance *= 2 per level
entry_short: Candle pattern (upper wick >= 40% of 100 pip minimum) + grid entry; lot += 2x per level; grid distance *= 2 per level
exit: take profit 5 USD; cut loss -3000 USD fixed
buildon_idea: Exponential grid (2x both distance + lot) is high-risk; add hard cap: Max Order limit (e.g. 10-15 levels); flat-lot test recommended first; grid_distance_multiplier=1.5 or 1 for safety
novelty_note: Exponential scaling of both grid distance and lot sizing is aggressive; novelty moderate - proven structure but needs position cap

title: Go Robot Scouting 2: 2-EMA + price pullback pattern + trailing stop
entry_long: EMA8 > EMA18 + price_close[10] > price_close[1] (pullback confirmation) -> buy 0.01L
entry_short: EMA8 < EMA18 + price_close[10] < price_close[1] (pullback confirmation) -> sell 0.01L
exit: grid add: 100 pips; trailing stop: money_loss 20 USD fixed; close profit at target
buildon_idea: EMA pullback pattern is clean; tested 2024 on XAU 5M: 50% profit, 2791 trades, DD 23.82%; extend to major pairs; test EMA8/18 sensitivity (try 5/15, 10/20); grid_100pips may compress on news spikes
novelty_note: EMA pullback + trailing_stop_money_loss is proven effective; XAU-specific results strong
